symptom: `grant read * on entity Shop.Customer to Shop.Clerk where [Name != '']` on a role that already had an unconstrained rule reported 'Granted access' and added a second rule; the role still read every row. exec, check and lint said nothing.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_security_write.go grantOverlapWarning; mdl/executor/validate_access_rule_overlap.go (ValidateAccessRuleOverlap no-project, CheckAccessRuleOverlap --references); wired in validate_program.go and cmd/mxcli/cmd_check.go. Test: mdl/executor/issue2320_access_rule_overlap_test.go
cause: A rule is keyed by role set plus constraint (#936), so a grant with a WHERE is a new rule, not a narrowing; access rules add up at runtime. That is correct model behaviour, but nothing said that the constraint limited nothing.
insight: **Report each overlap once, by where its other half comes from.** The check tracks per entity and role whether an unconstrained and a constrained rule are held and whether each came from the project or the script; the no-project pass reports script-vs-script overlaps and the --references pass only those involving a stored rule, so `check -p --references` does not print the same warning twice. `revoke all` clears the role (the documented way to narrow); a partial revoke changes rights, not which rules exist, so it clears nothing. exec prints the warning as a notice, so it still shows on a re-run that writes nothing (the overlap is still there). Live on 11.12.6: check --references and exec both warn; revoke all + grant where leaves one constrained rule and mx check reports 0 errors. Control: a constrained grant to a role with no unconstrained rule warns nothing.
